message.content:
This is a three-wheeled electric vehicle that seats two side by side and is designed for public roads. The question is whether it falls under heading 8703 (motor cars for transporting persons) or heading 8711 (motorcycles, including with sidecars).

CBP rulings on similar vehicles, such as the Arcimoto FUV and other enclosed three-wheelers, have gone both ways. Where the vehicle has a steering wheel, an enclosed cabin and side-by-side seating, CBP has generally classified it in 8703 as a motor vehicle for transporting persons. Heading 8711 has been used for vehicles with handlebars and straddle seating.

Within 8703, an electric vehicle with only an electric motor falls under subheading 8703.80 ("other vehicles, with only electric motor for propulsion"). The statistical suffix for this subheading is 8703.80.0100 ("Other vehicles, with only electric motor for propulsion"). I am recalling this suffix from memory and have not checked it against the current schedule.

predicted_reason: A three-wheeled, enclosed, steering-wheel-controlled vehicle with side-by-side seating for two, designed for public roads and propelled only by an electric motor, is classified as a motor vehicle for transporting persons under heading 8703, subheading 8703.80.
